title: FINDING (interpretive-disagreement, then RESOLVED): F002 original framing was based on wrong cause attribution
body: Hand-coding F002 surfaced that the prompt template is already small (~5KB). The original D007 hypothesis was 'implementer prompt template loads too much context' — but inventory found the template loads only plan_id + feature dict + steps + forbidden/required CLI lists. The 4.92M iter0 input_tokens came from elsewhere. Cost driver: ClaudeCLIExecutor.dispatch() aggregates `input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens` into a single `tokens_in` field. Cache_read accumulates across every agent tool-use turn — pytest output, file reads, etc. all get cache_read'd into context on every subsequent turn. Original D007 100:1 ratio was a measurement-attribution mistake: 'input tokens' was really 'sum of all input + cached-read sums across all turns of an autonomous agent loop'. The prompt template was never the issue. CLASSIFICATION: interpretive-disagreement (we built the wrong mental model of where cost comes from). RESOLUTION: F002 reshipped with the actual safe levers (see D016).

title: F002 (cost-lever ship) closed: --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections + TEST_DISCIPLINE_NOTE

(b) prompts.py exports TEST_DISCIPLINE_NOTE constant, threaded into both iter0 and iterN implementer prompt paths — instructs agent to prefer targeted tests over full sweeps with explicit rationale about cache_read accumulation. Tests: 11 new fixture tests in test_v3_f002_cost_levers.py pin both levers + 10KB prompt-size invariant; test_f005b_executor_argv updated for new flag position. Full orchestrate sweep 1828 passed / 7 skipped. title: v3.1 hot-fix: validate_prod_gates enum-vs-string coercion (SpinDine cross-repo dogfood)
body: Operator hit a real validator bug from a SpinDine v2 dispatch attempt — `validate_prod_gates` typed `human_gates` as `list[str]` but `plan_loader._load_plan` passes `plan.human_gates` (a `list[HumanGate]` per the Pydantic model). `HumanGate` is a plain Enum (not StrEnum), so `"pre_impl" in {HumanGate.pre_impl}` is always False and every required gate was reported missing. 4 SpinDine dispatch attempts blocked. CLASSIFICATION: feature_defect (same class as v3 F004 i1 findings — bug caught by cross-repo dogfood). FIX: defensive coerce on the validator side — `gates = {(g.value if hasattr(g, 'value') else g) for g in (human_gates or [])}`. Single-line set-comprehension; both str and Enum shapes round-trip correctly. 10 new fixture tests in test_validate_prod_gates_enum_coercion.py pin every case: enum members satisfy required, mixed str+enum, required_override path also coerces, no-regression on string-only inputs. Full sweep 1871 passed / 7 skipped. PATTERN: this is v3-class friction surfaced via cross-repo dogfood (SpinDine), exactly the mechanism v3 was designed to capture. v3.1 hot-fix shape (single commit + regression test + ledger entry); no separate plan needed because scope is one-line bugfix. SpinDine session can rebase and re-dispatch.

title: FINDING (interpretive_disagreement): codex auditor verdict=blocked on advisory-only finding terminated supervisor prematurely
body: Plan 010 F002 dispatch: codex auditor returned audit_status=blocked because its read-only sandbox couldn't run pytest. Single finding was severity=advisory, category=test_coverage — non-substantive per the F003 taxonomy (would classify as `environmental_reproduction_failure` if it were a real finding). But the supervisor terminated `blocked after 1 round` because the AUDITOR VERDICT STRING was 'blocked' — not because the FINDINGS warranted termination. Mismatch: a single advisory finding should not block, but the auditor's pre-emptive 'blocked' verdict string did. v3 F003 ENVIRONMENTAL_BLOCKER short-circuit fires on a *finding* with that class, not on the verdict string itself. CLASSIFICATION: interpretive_disagreement between the auditor's terminal verdict and the substantive content of its findings. Single occurrence so far — not a v4 cluster trigger. Watch for repeats. Candidate fix would be supervisor reconciling: if auditor verdict=blocked but ALL findings are advisory-only, treat as paused_on_gate (or even signed_off-with-environmental-note), not blocked-terminal.
